d: Short, messy charcoal-grey hair with choppy bangs and a single stray strand hanging over the right side of the face, paired with large, expressive amber-brown eyes. An adolescent face with a youthful appearance and a slender build. The outfit consists of a dark navy sleeveless sailor-style dress with a white collar and orange trim, a white necktie, a dark grey peaked cap over a red bandana, and a single black fingerless glove on the left hand. Signature details include a small grey mechanical turret attached to the left shoulder and black headphones worn over the ears.
